Corum's 10.3 carries/game shrink, it becomes a dropback game, and Nacua plus LAC's actual L3 targets (Gadsden 14, Harris 9) are the paths — a shootout the 46.5 does not price as the base.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Corum has been a real complement, 31 carries for 154 and 7 targets for 79 over the last three (about 78 rush+rec a game), against a 58.5 line, and LAC allows 4.34 YPC with 19 runs of 10+ in a Rams -6.5 run script.
edge_players.must_be_true: Rams are level or leading so the Williams/Corum split stays near 10 carries for Corum, and he keeps at least a modest receiving piece (he only needs about 8-15 rec yards if the 51 rush yards repeat).
edge_players.kills_it: LAC leads and LAR passes out of the two-back grind, or the 79 rec yards were one explosive and he finishes near 6 carries for 25 with empty receiving. Kyren taking 20+ carries in a pure grind also caps him.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Herbert has 17 carries for 120 rush yards over LAC's last three, about 40 a game versus a 24.5 line, and LAR blitzes 30% in a trailing script where his EPA/dropback is already -0.28, which is an escape environment rather than a clean pocket.
edge_players.must_be_true: The 17 attempts are a role across the three games, not one 70-yard scramble plus scraps, and Rams pressure turns into scrambles instead of sacks (sack totals are not in the pack).
edge_players.kills_it: Efficiency regresses to about 4.5 YPC on 5-6 attempts (roughly 25, a push) or the 120 yards are one explosive week; a sack-heavy blitz or a quick-game plan with LAC somehow ahead wipes the over.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because the Rams' lead never forced a grind and never forced Herbert to escape: LAR won a one-score game throwing to Nacua, Kyren took 18 of the RB carries, and Corum's 79 receiving yards from the prior three weeks were two explosives that did not repeat, so he finished 7 carries for 28 and one catch for 6 (34, under 58.5). Herbert's 120 rush yards were one long scramble in the window; against a 30% blitz he took two sacks and finished 3 carries for 9, under 24.5. The missing per-game splits and missing sack chart are exactly what would have made that counter stronger than the read — it is close, which is why both are leans, but the carry counts (31 and 17) are too large to treat as single plays, so the counter does not yet beat the read.
slip_story: One story only: Rams lead and run, Chargers chase into a 30% blitz. Corum rush+rec over is the clock/carry-share anchor; Herbert rush over is the pressure-escape correlate. Do not add LAC RB overs (Hampton, Vidal, Mitchell need the opposite script), do not add Nacua or a shootout total over (those need LAR to keep throwing), and do not add TDs. Two legs, one market per player. Read only — not a placed bet.
